thread:
Anna K: Quick sync—NovaCore wants a joint perf run next week. Goal: perf/W numbers + kernel tuning feeds for their new board. Who's good to own scheduling and telemetry?
Carlos M: I can coordinate the instrumentation plan. Need to confirm board inventory + power probe access. @Mei can you share the bench rig list?
Mei Zhang: I have 2 racks with NovaCore dev-boards and one Ampere shelf. Power probes: 2 high-res, 1 basic. I'll push docs here: https://redwood-internal/shares/bench/novacore
Dinesh R: I'll take throughput scripts and the workload mix. Proposal: run 3 sequence lengths (64/128/512) across batch sizes [1,4,8], collect p50/p95 and watt readings.
Anna K: Sounds good. Also want kernel-level traces for the 512 runs. @bench-bot can you kick off the agent to capture nvprof/telemetry during the canary?
bench-bot: scheduled job created: bench/1912345678-novacore-thermal-sweep. Commands:
```
./run_bench.sh --model gpt-3-8k --seq 512 --batches 1,4,8 --collect nvprof,power
```
Expect ~6h per sweep.
Carlos M: Can we shorten by sampling only batch=8 for initial kernel tuning, then full sweep after kernel patch?
Mei Zhang: Yes, we should do a quick pass: batch=8 on both boards, collect kernels + power. If it looks off, do full sweep.
Dinesh R: Also let's record ambient temp and PSU rail voltages. Last time thermal throttling skewed perf/W.
Anna K: Logistics: NovaCore liaison (Priya) asked for public-ready numbers by EOW next week. We should avoid publishing anything until HW partner approves.
Carlos M: Noted. I'll draft the joint statement template and ask legal/PR for review. @Mei make sure lab photos are NDA-cleared before sharing.
Mei Zhang: Will do. Lab photos: none until PR says go.
Dinesh R: I'll upload a trimmed CSV and the initial plots to /s3/bench-results/novacore/draft.
bench-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-bench-results/novacore/draft/1912345678-sample.csv
Anna K: OK — action items:
- Carlos: draft PR template + partner approval loop
- Mei: confirm board/probe availability + no photos
- Dinesh: run initial batch=8 pass, upload results
- bench-bot: run scheduled sweep and collect nvprof + power
Ping me when initial pass is done. :thumbsup:
Carlos M: On it.
Mei Zhang: Starting rig prep today.
Dinesh R: ETA initial pass tomorrow noon PT.
Anna K: Great. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after Dinesh's upload. :)
